notes.title: Bug Update! Oops, I mean Fixes.
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I’m still on a bug-hunting mission—some of them hide so deep that reaching them isn’t easy, but progress is steady.[/p][h3]Highlights of this update[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a critical bug that stopped [b]hints on the final level[/b] from working.
They now display correctly, so you can finally finish the game![/p][/*][*][p]Some minor bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your patience and support. Enjoy the game![/p]
